subject.title: clawhub install does not register skill hooks automatically

question: Should installing a ClawHub skill be allowed to register executable OpenClaw hooks, and what declaration, scanning, disclosure, trust, and user-consent rules must gate that activation?
rationale: Current main treats skill copying and code-plugin installation as separate surfaces, while the requested behavior would cross into executable gateway activation.

options.title: Prompted Registration
options.body: Detect a typed hook declaration, show scan and permission details, and require explicit confirmation before registration.

options.title: Manual Registration
options.body: Keep activation separate but emit a prominent post-install warning with the exact registration and restart steps.

options.title: Trusted Auto-Registration
options.body: Permit automatic activation only for a narrowly defined vetted or official package tier with an auditable policy.

recommendation.title: Prompted Registration
recommendation.body: Detect a typed hook declaration, show scan and permission details, and require explicit confirmation before registration.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current install path and provide the strongest available decision-routing signal from the related hook and post-install discussions.
